🛡️ Welcome to Mall Security Simulator! 🛡️

Join Metavision for a $500 CASH BONUS!!

As a dedicated mall security guard, it's your duty to maintain a peaceful and secure environment. Handle unruly shoppers, catch shoplifters, and thwart potential troublemakers to earn points and climb the ranks! Buy and trade pets to help you progress faster!

👍 Like the game

Join Metavision to keep up with any news on future updates or give us your ideas!
